hotel_name: Five Elements Hotels - Delhi (Hotel North Avenue)

positive_snippets:
Good Stay
I am extremely happy with the housekeeping services. The staff is very hardworking, honest, and professional. The room and bathroom are cleaned thoroughly, and everything is done properly and on time.
The staff’s behavior is very polite and helpful. The level of cleanliness is truly commendable, and their dedication to work is clearly visible.
I would definitely recommend front office team to everyone.
Excellent work, keep it up 👍

Stayed at Hotel Five Elements on 6th March. It is a very good and well-maintained hotel. The rooms were clean and comfortable, and the overall service was nice. The price is worth it for the quality they provide. Breakfast was also good with decent options included. Overall, it was a pleasant stay and I would recommend this hotel to others. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Rating: 4.6/5

I had an excellent stay at the Five Elements Hotel. The service was outstanding, and the staff was consistently courteous and helpful. The room was superb—clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The food was excellent, with great quality and taste.
I would especially like to mention Mr. Bittu Singh, who kindly arranged a cab for sightseeing in Delhi. The cab driver, Ankit, was extremely polite, professional, and made the local travel experience very pleasant.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Delhi.
